🛠 Shutdown = Update! 🛠 
🐧 Welcome to Penguin Tycoon! 🐧

⭐ HOW TO PLAY

Buy Penguins 🐧 
Penguins drop Fish over time 🐟
Deposit Fish to earn Money 💰
Use Money to buy more Penguins 💵
Merge Penguins to get higher-tier Penguins 🔧
Penguins drop Eggs over time 🥚
Hatch Eggs to get extra Penguins 🎁
Unlock new Penguins and expand your collection! ⭐

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
